description: This file defines the CustomerOptionValueService interface, which extends generic service functionalities for CustomerOptionValue entities, including methods to list, save, update, and retrieve option values by code within a customer attribute management context.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueService
classes.description: Interface for customer option value services, providing methods for listing, saving, updating, and retrieving customer option values.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValues associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOptionValue or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue based on store and code.
